rules.qualityOutput: First 30 keyframes after tone mapping; retain every third (3, 6, ... 30), as consecutively numbered native PNGs.
rules.isolatedInput: Decode one original frame with side data; upload once before looping GPU frames for hardware filters; use wrapped_avframe to the null muxer, with no download or pixel encoding.
rules.unsupportedMetadata: N/A; no speed or quality score when the implementation ignores the selected signal's metadata.
rules.runtimeProof: Filter inventories and filter help do not prove GPU/device/driver executability or metadata delivery.

implementations.label: libplacebo (reference)
implementations.notes: Fixed Quality reference from stock FFmpeg, excluded from performance comparisons. Performance libplacebo is the separate Emby-build entry. HDR10+ applicability follows the primary instructions; absence of an apply_hdr10p option is not proof of absent libplacebo HDR10+ processing. Metadata delivery requires native preflight on the original clips.

implementations.label: libplacebo
implementations.notes: Performance-only libplacebo from the configured Emby development FFmpeg, paired with embytonemap_vulkan using the same binary and selected GPU. Quality retains its separate stock-libplacebo reference. Options and eight comparison curves match the stock catalog entry; native binary/device/residency preflight remains mandatory.

implementations.label: swscale perceptual
implementations.notes: swscale is the library; its FFmpeg filter is scale. The supplied build exposes perceptual HDR conversion, PQ and HLG transfers. HDR10 synthetic processing was tested locally. Dynamic HDR10+ mapping and DV P5 reshaping are not established, so those cases are N/A. Quality execution must retain native dimensions. For HDR10 Quality, include its native perceptual conversion in Spline comparisons without adding a curve option.

implementations.label: tonemap (zscale linear input)
implementations.notes: Needs linear float input from zscale and an SDR conversion afterwards; no BT.2390 option.

implementations.label: tonemap_opencl
implementations.notes: Operators up to mobius only; no BT.2390, ST.2094 or HDR10+ options.

implementations.label: embytonemap (high)
implementations.notes: Supported signals are HLG, HDR10, HDR10+ and Dolby Vision P5. Native decoded input and native NV12 output need no format wrappers. Signal-specific metadata application flags are enabled only for the corresponding source. High is the quality-oriented mode.

implementations.label: embytonemap (fast)
implementations.notes: Supported signals are HLG, HDR10, HDR10+ and Dolby Vision P5. Native decoded input and native NV12 output need no format wrappers. Signal-specific metadata application flags are enabled only for the corresponding source. Fast uses the quality=fast option.

implementations.label: embytonemap_cuda
implementations.notes: Replacement Emby 8.0-emby_2026_10_02 CUDA preflights passed isolated, full hardware transcode and native-quality export on all five enabled clips. HDR10+ and Dolby Vision P5 logs report native metadata application. Runtime checks validate ordinary SDR stream summaries and GPU residency; individual frame metadata delivery is not observed.

implementations.label: embytonemap_opencl
implementations.notes: New OpenCL implementation. Configured vendor/device must be checked against the actual OpenCL device and exclusions before execution. GPU execution unverified.

implementations.label: embytonemap_vulkan
implementations.notes: Development Emby filter help declares Vulkan frames in/out and all eight comparison curves. Source configuration requires P010 input and NV12 output surfaces. Output format, BT.709 transfer/matrix/primaries and TV range are explicit; metadata flags are enabled only for the matching signal. It has no quality option. Help-listed capability does not establish hardware decode, mapping, scaling or encoding success; each configured binary/device route must pass native preflight.

implementations.label: supertonemap
implementations.notes: Previous SIMD implementation; help confirms bt2390 in this supplied build. Use p010le input and nv12 output; no documented dynamic HDR10+ or DV P5 path.

implementations.label: extratonemap_opencl
implementations.notes: Previous Intel-only OpenCL path. No bt2390 option in the supplied filter help. Requires a confirmed Intel OpenCL device; no dynamic HDR10+ or DV P5 path.

implementations.label: supertonemap_opencl
implementations.notes: Previous Intel-only legacy path. Input and output are BGRA. Isolated converts to BGRA in software and restores the BT.2020 matrix tag that the filter asserts; Full Transcode converts to BGRA with vpp_qsv on the GPU before mapping to OpenCL. No dynamic HDR10+ or DV P5 path.

implementations.label: tonemap_cuda (previous)
implementations.notes: Previous CUDA implementation; no Dolby Vision or HDR10+ options.

implementations.label: tonemapx
implementations.notes: The supplied Jellyfin 8.1.2 family implements HLG, HDR10 and Dolby Vision P5. Native Windows software/OpenCL/CUDA probes passed all three test modes on the HLG clip. No dynamic HDR10+ control or ST2094-40 operator is exposed. Mapper peak=100 follows Jellyfin Server v12.1 production defaults; scaling remains after mapping for this benchmark. Native output format is selected by the mapper; CUDA NV12 is the declared common hardware output choice.

implementations.label: tonemap (Plex PQ)
implementations.notes: HDR10 interface and matching external HEVC/H.264/x264 modules verified against official Plex codec metadata. Original 4K HEVC decode succeeds. Each software/CUDA route still requires a runtime preflight with native SDR output and GPU residency. This Plex build cannot export execution graph HTML. Plex Media Server runs this filter as format=p010,tonemap=hable without hardware acceleration and with Intel QSV, where D3D11VA decodes into system memory and h264_qsv encodes. It also runs it for HLG and HDR10+, but applies no HDR10+ metadata and does not decode HLG correctly, so only HDR10 is compared. DV P5 is not supported.

implementations.label: tonemap_cuda
implementations.notes: HDR10 interface and matching external HEVC/H.264/x264 modules verified against official Plex codec metadata. Original 4K HEVC decode succeeds. Each software/CUDA route still requires a runtime preflight with native SDR output and GPU residency. This Plex build cannot export execution graph HTML. Plex Media Server also runs tonemap_cuda=hable:nv12 for HLG and HDR10+, but applies no HDR10+ metadata and does not decode HLG correctly, so only HDR10 is compared. DV P5 is not supported.
